04

Things that are true

01Recruited himself into his first copywriting job. It worked.
02Holds three master's degrees. One of them is an MFA in fiction.
03Took a cold bath 385 days in a row, then stopped, on purpose.
04Was a professional juggler before he juggled clients.
05Founded and ran a clothing brand called The Casual Cult.
06Spent a year as a college professor and lived to tell it.
07Has lost count of the tattoos. This is not a metaphor.
08Moved to Denmark in 2022 and is still negotiating with the language.

Bud Light.

At VaynerMedia, Bud Light was one of my biggest accounts: national spots, social films, and live events, all in a voice that knew exactly how dumb and how fun beer is meant to be.

NFL spots introducing the redesigned cans, built to feel like a tradition rather than a launch.

Whatever, USA, a town Bud Light took over for a weekend. Working with an art director and Mosaic, I directed the video and photo crews on the ground and mapped the entire content calendar before we arrived.

The Bud-E Fridge launch, a fridge that tells you when the beer is cold. I wrote the spot, helped direct, and was on set throughout.
